Top Land shopfront — shamba.online/topland

Only crops with an expected harvest are listed, on the shop and in the customer order section.

No payment step: reservations are confirmed by the farm and settled on collection.

Bracketed text is a real fact I don't have — address, phone, collection days, notice period.

Produce, weights and prices are sample values shaped like the Harvest ETA data that would fill them.
